title: GitHub Administration Hub
summary: A multi-organization administration app bringing GitHub access, repository health, security, Copilot adoption, and costs into one workspace.
description: GitHub Administration Hub combines organization management and operational visibility in a single interface. Dedicated views cover members, teams, roles, repositories, audit events, webhooks, and GitHub Actions, reducing the need to move between separate administration pages.

Governance views surface repository posture, security alerts, public-repository oversight, and configuration drift. Copilot adoption and seat-management views sit alongside billing and cost-allocation tools so administrators can explore usage and spending in context.

The application pairs a React and TypeScript frontend with a Node.js and Express backend. GitHub App OAuth provides individual sign-in, and organization switching, cached queries, and API rate-limit visibility support work across multiple organizations. Available data and actions depend on the configured GitHub permissions.

highlights: Repository, access, security, and governance views
Copilot adoption and cost visibility alongside operations
